description: This file defines the Scriptlet class, which encapsulates a small script segment consisting of a language identifier and a script body. It provides functionality to parse the script, execute it with a given context, and generate its string representation.

classes.name: Scriptlet
classes.description: A class representing a scriptlet with its language and script content, capable of executing the script within a provided context.

methods.name: Scriptlet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Scriptlet with a script string in the format 'language:script'.

methods.name: executeScript
methods.description: Executes the encapsulated script with the provided context and returns the result.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the scriptlet in the format 'language:script'.
